## Palmeiras v RB Bragantino: title push meets Sudamericana chase

Palmeiras host RB Bragantino in the Brasileirão on Saturday, 24 October 2026 in Barueri, with the hosts one point off top spot and the visitors sitting 10th in the Sudamericana places. [...] Palestra are without Andreas Pereira and Joaquin Piquerez through suspension, while Jefté and Vitor Roque are injured. Massa Bruta miss Eric Ramires (suspended), with Henry Mosquera, Rodriguinho and Davi Gomes sidelined. [...] A win would move Palestra to 69 points and could send them top of the table in the title race. Braga would climb to 44 points and may edge up the pack, strengthening their Copa Sudamericana qualification push.

data.title: Palmeiras vs Bragantino Predictions and Betting Tips
data.content:
# Palmeiras vs Bragantino Predictions, Team News and Betting Tips

Palmeiras host Bragantino at Allianz Parque on Saturday 24 October, kick-off 22:30 UK, with the league's best defence on show. Palmeiras sit 2nd on 66 points from 31 games, 19 wins and just three defeats. Bragantino are 10th on 41 points, having lost 12 times. [...] Palmeiras possible starting lineup:  
Carlos Miguel; Giay, Gómez, Murilo, Barboza; Freitas, Evangelista, Arthur Gabriel; Mauricio, Sosa, López

Bragantino possible starting lineup:  
Volpi; Guzmán Rodríguez, Alix, Gabriel, Juninho Capixaba; Fabinho, Ryan Augusto Tavares da Silva; Lucas Barbosa, Eduardo Sasha, Wallace Yan; Fernando

## Players to watch [...] Bragantino have won two, drawn four and lost four of their last ten. The latest was a 1-1 at Remo on Sunday, preceded by a 4-2 home win over Cruzeiro and a 1-1 draw with Mirassol. Before that came a 1-0 loss at Atlético-MG and a 2-1 defeat at Flamengo.

Bragantino have the 3rd most shots on target in the league at 5.42 a game and the 2nd most corners at 5.97. Their cards, 2.81 a game, are the 3rd most.
